seo_title: Join Net Impact IU | Membership for All IU Majors
seo_description: Join Net Impact Indiana University. Open to IU Bloomington undergraduates from any major. Fill out the membership form and come to a Monday meeting.
headline: Join Net Impact IU
intro: Net Impact IU is open to Indiana University Bloomington undergraduates from any major and any year. Membership applications are open all year, and joining takes three steps.

steps.title: Come to a Monday meeting
steps.text: General meetings are Mondays, 7:00 to 8:00 pm. Join the GroupMe and follow Instagram for the room and announcements.

steps.title: Get involved
steps.text: Apply for a project team (applications typically open the second week of the semester) and sign up for events.
